subject: Deliverability policy alignment + cutover cadence for Neptune Health migration
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@neptunehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverability policy alignment + cutover cadence for Neptune Health migration

Hi all —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I wanted to capture the open asks and propose a tight cadence so we can lock the migration window and communications. Attachments: a working mutual action plan (MAP-NeptuneHealth.xlsx) and the latest cutover runbook stub (cutover-runbook-v2.pdf).

Open questions we flagged and need a decision on by EOD 2028-07-31:
- Deliverability policy: can we allow the existing embed endpoint for a 48-hour read-only grace period post-cutover (escape hatch) or do we require immediate disablement?
- Cutover cadence: Neptune requested a weekend cutover (Sat night) vs. Tue off-peak. Please confirm internal ops preference.
- Customer comms: one-stage vs. staged emails/SDK notices (SDK warning + API deprecation email). Who owns the final copy?
- Contract amendment: procurement asked for a short DocuSign amendment to reflect dedicated capacity start date.

Suggested plan (if no objections):
- Target window: Sat, 2028-08-03 22:00 PDT -> Sunday ramp-check 04:00 PDT
- Escape hatch: enable read-only old endpoint toggle for 48 hrs (flagged, not discoverable)
- Comms cadence: SDK in-app warning (owned by Neptune eng) + Redwood deprecation email on Thu 2028-08-01, cutover reminder on Fri 08/02, and post-cutover confirmation on Sun 08/04.

Can you confirm availability for the window and the escape hatch? Ben / Marissa, if ops is comfortable with Sat night we need to get DocuSign ready (link in related links).

-Neha
Director, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@neptunehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverability policy alignment + cutover cadence for Neptune Health migration

Thanks Neha. Quick notes:
- Ops can support Sat 8/3 22:00 -> Sun 8/4 window but we should keep a hard rollback cut at +6 hours if key metrics degrade (latency error rate).
- The 48-hr read-only escape hatch is fine from infra perspective, but it will still count against token billing unless we add a transient mapping — product needs to confirm if billing exemption is required.
- I can own the runbook checklists and cutover telemetry (alerts/dashboards). Marissa: can you confirm staff rotation and on-call overlap?

If procurement needs DocuSign earlier, loop me in and I’ll get legal to prioritize the amendment review.

—Ben
Senior Customer Engineering Manager

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@neptunehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neptune Health Procurement <procurement@neptunehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jul 2028 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverability policy alignment + cutover cadence for Neptune Health migration

Hi Neha / Ben —

Thanks — Sat night is our preference (min traffic and we can have our on-call present). A couple of clarifying items from procurement/engineering:
- Procurement attached the PO for the reserved capacity (po-78945.pdf). We’ll need the signed amendment before the capacity start date; can Redwood provide the DocuSign link today if possible?
- SDK deprecation: our client mobile team asked that SDK warnings be in place at least 72 hours before cutover. We’ll prepare that but need the exact message copy.
- Regarding billing: Neptune cannot accept surprise charges for the 48-hr escape hatch. If the escape hatch will be billable, we need a one-time credit or a scoped mapping that counts as free for the first 48 hours.

If you can circulate draft comm copy by EOD Thu 7/31 we’ll align internal stakeholders.

—Sara
Head of Integrations
Neptune Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@neptunehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverability policy alignment + cutover cadence for Neptune Health migration

All —

Ops comments and actionables:
- Staff: I’ll staff primary runbook lead (Marissa) + secondary (Karthik) for the window. Ben will monitor telemetry and ramp decisions. On-call overlap confirmed 21:30–06:00 PDT.
- Rollback: we accept a +6 hour hard rollback hold if critical latency or token-error > 2% sustained. We’ll document exact metrics in cutover-runbook-v2.pdf.
- Escape hatch billing: product flagged that the old endpoint maps to the same serving pool; billing will apply. Legal/product can approve a one-time courtesy credit for the 48-hr window. Ben, please coordinate with finance to surface the amount (estimate: sample credit line included in MAP).
- Comms: proposed copy (draft below) — Neha please iterate and send final to Sara: 

Draft deprecation notice (short):
"On Aug 3, 2028 at 10:00 PM PDT we will cut over your API to the dedicated endpoint for improved throughput and latency. During a 48-hour read-only grace period the legacy endpoint will be available for reads only. Please update SDKs and references; contact support if you need assistance"

Marissa will also prepare a short runbook annex for DB owners and a rollback checklist. I’ve attached the runbook v2 with placeholders for metric thresholds.

I’ll also raise a small procurement/finance item for the courtesy credit and get a number by Fri 7/29 EOD. If we can finalize the DocuSign by Mon 7/31 we’ll be in good shape.

-Marissa
Director, Product Operations

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@neptunehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deliverability policy alignment + cutover cadence for Neptune Health migration

Thanks everyone —closing the loop with decisions and owners:

Decisions (final):
- Cutover window: Sat 2028-08-03 22:00 PDT (confirmed).
- Escape hatch: 48-hour read-only old endpoint allowed; Redwood to apply a one-time courtesy credit to Neptune for that 48-hour period.
- Rollback: hard rollback at +6 hours for sustained critical errors (>2% token/error sustained for 10 minutes).
- Comms: Marissa to own runbook and cutover communications; Sara to own the SDK in-app warning. Neha to send the public-facing deprecation email copy by Thu 2028-08-01 17:00 PDT.
- DocuSign: legal to provide amendment link; Ben please escalate if not live by EOD Mon 2028-07-31.

Action owners:
- Marissa: finalize runbook annex & metric thresholds (due Fri 7/29 EOD) — attachment: cutover-runbook-v2.pdf
- Ben: telemetry dashboards & finance coordinate credit (estimate due Fri 7/29 EOD)
- Sara: SDK warning copy + confirm procurement PO (received po-78945.pdf)
- Neha: finalize deprecation email and schedule send (Thu 8/1 17:00 PDT)

If anyone needs to escalate exceptions (ex: extend escape hatch or change window), please raise by Tue 7/31 12:00 PDT so we can route to legal/product for approval. I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite for the runbook dry-run on Thu 8/1 09:00 PDT.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

-Neha
Director, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference
